audit.whatIsWrong: Row 1 was given to Malphite under a why that reads 'Level 2 is your window', row 2 to Malphite under a why that reads 'evens out', and row 6 to Malphite.
audit.why: The audited mirror set the chart to Skill / Zaahen / Skill / Skill / Skill / Malphite / Skill, softening two-plus items from Malphite to Skill. Zaahen's E deals percent-health damage, which is the answer to a stacked-armour, 10%-max-health-shield opponent.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2 and 6 flipped as matched full+content pairs; whys[6] rewritten so it no longer argues the opposite of its own row.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appears anywhere on the page — the packet flags exactly this ('NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'). Unstoppable Force is also called 'point-and-click'.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100 at 1000 range and Riot's text says he 'launches himself to a location' — it is aimed at ground and can be sidestepped, which changes the advice from 'respect it' to 'make him miss it'. Ground Slam is a flat 7s, Thunderclap 10s at rank 1, Seismic Shard a flat 8s.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, spikes[1].text, spikes[2].text and spikes[3].text, with the location-targeting corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three mechanical errors. The page attributes the shield to his W ('his W passive shield', 'before his W shield can soak your poke') — the shield is Granite Shield, his passive, and W is Thunderclap. It says Ground Slam is an 'armor-shred'; it is not. And it never states the one thing that beats him.
audit.why: Riot's text: Granite Shield 'absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health' and recharges only 'if Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds' — so continuous pressure, not burst, is what keeps it off. Ground Slam 'deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies' — it scales off his armour, it does not remove yours. And Zaahen's E carries percent-health damage, which is precisely what a 10%-max-health shield and an armour stack do not answer.
audit.corrected: Shield reattributed to the passive in wants.you[1], wants.foe[1] and spikes[2].text; the armour-shred claim removed from spikes[1].text; the percent-health answer written into spikes[3].text and whys[6]; the Thunderclap auto-reset tell into dontsFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text says 'His 50%+ win rate lives here'. The 50.57% belongs to Zaahen, not Malphite.
audit.why: A reader told the enemy holds the win rate will play an even lane as a losing one.
audit.corrected: Attributed to you and tied to the behaviour that earns it — keeping Granite Shield broken.

edits.before: At first item Malphite spikes — stacked armor and E make your physical damage bounce off.
edits.after: At first item Malphite spikes — stacked armour plus Ground Slam blunts your attacks.

edits.before: Two items of armor make him an unbreakable duelist you can't out-DPS.
edits.after: Two items in, your E's percent-health damage cuts through his armour stack.

edits.before: - Malphite Unstoppable Force: matchup-defining — His engage. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Unstoppable Force: 130s at rank 1, 1000 range, aimed at a location — sidestep it. - Ground Slam: a flat 7s, cuts your attack speed. - Granite Shield recharges only while he goes unhit, so never fully disengage.

edits.before: His engage. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 130s at rank 1 and aimed at ground — sidestep, then commit.

edits.before: That is Malphite's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Granite Shield absorbs up to 10% of his max health — break it before you commit.

edits.before: Coin-flipping into an unknown matchup — respect what you have not seen until you have seen it twice.
edits.after: Thunderclap opens on an attack wind-up, not a cast — step back on the animation.

edits.before: Malphite's R Unstoppable Force is a point-and-click knock-up that sets up a jungle gank or a full combo — this is where he stops being a farm target. Never step past your minions at 6 without knowing his flank; his ult plus E Ground Slam armor-shred trade can flip on you even though your sustained damage is higher.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force is a 130s dash to a location that knocks you up — not point-and-click, so it can be sidestepped, and it is the whole reason he is a threat at 6. Never step past your minions without knowing his flank. Ground Slam does not shred your armour; it scales off his and cuts your attack speed.

edits.before: He spikes hard building armor plate items (Sunfire, Iceborn): his passive shield is near-permanent, E slows your attack speed, and your physical damage gets shrugged off. His 50%+ win rate lives here — respect that armor stacking gutts your Q and auto damage.
edits.after: He spikes building armour items (Sunfire, Iceborn): Granite Shield recharges whenever he goes a few seconds unhit, and Ground Slam (7s) cuts your attack speed. The 50.6% win rate here is yours, not his — keep hitting him so the shield never comes back.

edits.before: Two items of armor and Malphite is a rock you can't crack one-on-one while his R engages your team. Pivot to split-pressure and objective play rather than dueling; you simply don't out-DPS a full-armor Malphite through his shield, so use your Q waveclear to threaten sides instead.
edits.after: Two items of armour and he is hard to crack — but Granite Shield caps at 10% of his max health and your E deals percent-health damage, so armour alone is not his answer. Keep the shield broken by staying on him, and take the side lane whenever his 130s R is spent.

edits.before: Trade in short bursts before his W shield can soak your poke
edits.after: Trade in bursts while Granite Shield is already broken off

edits.before: Stack armor items so your physical damage bounces off his shield
edits.after: Stack armour and go unhit so Granite Shield keeps recharging

notes: The kit file gives Malphite's Q and E a 'grounding' flag, but Riot's own descriptions say only 'stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds' (Q) and 'reduces the Attack Speed' (E). Per the rule that the description beats a derived flag, I wrote nothing claiming Malphite can ground your E dash — but if that flag is right it is the most important interaction on the page, so it is worth a human checking. Same for the 'shield' flag on Thunderclap, whose text mentions no shield. Zaahen's ability names remain unverifiable from his kit file; slot letters used.
